title: His Unlived Life
subtitle: Why I'm sharing my story
label: New essay
alt_text: An early color photograph of a basket of pink roses at the base of a stone column, dimmed behind the title His Unlived Life in large serif capitals. Not Plain.

captions.facebook:
“Why I’m sharing: to let others know they’re not alone, to validate the experiences of people who have lived through something like this, and to honor my dad, his life, as well as his unlived life.”

I’ve always felt called to share my story. This is a short one about why.

New essay on Not Plain. Read it here:
https://sarahnotplain.substack.com/p/his-unlived-life

pinterest.description: A short memoir essay on why she is sharing her story: to let others know they are not alone, and to honor her dad, his life and his unlived life. On grief, trauma, survival and the belief that with death comes life. From Not Plain, a memoir newsletter by Sarah.

captions.substack: I wrote a short one about why I’m sharing my story at all. To let others know they’re not alone, and to honor my dad, his life, and his unlived life.
